leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Tabs compound component using React Context for state sharing
Implement a TabList component that renders clickable tab headers
Configure a TabPanel component that displays content based on active tab
Initialize and manage the active tab state within the Tabs provider
Bind click handlers to Tab components to control tab switching
Render a complete tab interface with synchronized headers and panels
Integrate custom styling and props into each compound component part
